title: thalictrum minus var. procerum
intro: Thalictrum minus var. procerum, commonly known as Dwarf Meadow Rue, is a perennial flowering plant belonging to the family Ranunculaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as an antiseptic. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Dwarf Meadow Rue include reducing fever, soothing skin irritations, and aiding in wound healing.
